mechanism: Pyrazinamide may increase verapamil levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, potentially enhancing cardiovascular effects; additionally, both drugs can cause hyperuricemia and verapamil may mask tachycardia from pyrazinamide-induced adverse effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and ECG parameters during concurrent use; consider verapamil dose adjustment if hyperuricemia develops or cardiac effects intensify.
